keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «외계인의 우주선이 고장 났다(문제)» 와 «내가 외계인이 집에 가도록 도왔다(해결)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (the alien’s ship is broken) and the solution (I help the alien go home). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Me and a little green alien with three eyes
The alien’s ship is broken, and he is crying.
I give him my toy wrench, and the ship works again.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

sum.pre: Something falls into my backyard at night. It is a tiny
. The ship works again, and he flies home to the stars.

words: Bang! Something falls into my backyard at night.
a small light you hold in your hand
a ship that flies in space
The door opens, and a little green alien comes out.
a living thing from another planet
a tool for turning and fixing things

opts: He is afraid of my flashlight.
evs: I run outside with a flashlight.
why: 외계인이 «My ship is broken» 이라고 말해요. 우주선이 고장 나서 울고 있어요.
The alien says, "My ship is broken." That is why he is crying.

qs.q: "My ship is broken," he says. What does "broken" mean here?
qs.qko: «My ship is broken» 에서 «broken» 은 무슨 뜻일까요?
evs: Bang! Something falls into my backyard at night.
The door opens, and a little green alien comes out.
I helped an alien go home!
why: «Zap! The ship works again.» 스패너를 주자 우주선이 «다시» 움직여요. 그러니 «broken» 은 움직이지 않는다는 뜻이에요.
After I give him the wrench, the ship works again. So "broken" means not working.

qs.q: How does the alien get home?
opts: I give him my toy wrench, and his ship works again.
He walks home through the woods.
My dad drives him home in a car.
evs: I give him my toy wrench.
He has three eyes, and he is crying.
I run outside with a flashlight.
why: 내가 장난감 스패너를 주었고(«I give him my toy wrench.»), 우주선이 다시 움직였어요(«Zap! The ship works again.»). 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
I give him my toy wrench, and then the ship works again, so he can fly home. You need both sentences.

ends: The alien comes back to visit me with his family.
외계인이 가족과 함께 다시 나를 만나러 온다.
I fly to the alien’s planet in his tiny spaceship.
나는 외계인의 조그만 우주선을 타고 외계인 행성에 간다.

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «내 생각 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write your own idea and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because he is smiling)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because he is smiling)
write.src: “I think <u>the alien is happy</u> because <u>his ship works again</u>.”

img.cover: At night in a grassy backyard under a starry sky, a boy with messy brown hair in blue striped pajamas and red slippers waves a small orange toy wrench, while a little green alien with three big round eyes and two short antennae waves back from the round window of a tiny silver spaceship that glows and zooms up toward the stars.

scenes.1: In a dark grassy backyard lit by a flashlight beam, a little green alien with three big round eyes and two short antennae steps out of the open door of a tiny silver spaceship with a puff of gray smoke coming from its side, crying big tears, while a boy with messy brown hair in blue striped pajamas and red slippers kneels down and stares in surprise with the flashlight in his hand.
scenes.2: In a grassy backyard at night, a boy with messy brown hair in blue striped pajamas and red slippers hands a small orange toy wrench to a little green alien with three big round eyes and two short antennae, and the tiny silver spaceship next to them crackles with blue sparks as its lights blink back on.
